summary: Retest of two previously-reported Push Code bugs — BOTH FIXES VERIFIED at viewport 390x844 on https://drag-code-app.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) Long-press on filename-lang-picker now opens the Command Palette: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:850-855 has onLongPress={setCommandQuery('');setCommandIndex(0);setShowCommandPalette(true)} + delayLongPress={350}. Simulated a pointer down/hold-700ms/up gesture on the filename; command-palette-modal appeared and command-push was reachable and visible (356x54); tapping command-push opened push-modal. (2) Share tab clipboard fallback works on web: with navigator.share deleted and navigator.clipboard.writeText stubbed, tapping push-share-btn produced push-status text 'Copied hello.py to clipboard — the Web Share API is unavailable in this browser.' with computed color rgb(76,175,80) (green success) — matches spec exactly. clipboard.writeText WAS called (captured 31-byte content = the editor's default code). No red error surfaced. src/lib/push.ts:171-204 shareViaNative correctly returns { kind: 'clipboard', message: ... } and PushModal.doShare (PushModal.tsx:139-141) renders it with ok:true (green). Skipped previously-passing tests per agent note. Webhook httpbin CORS remains a known env limitation (skipped). Deprecation warnings observed but pre-existing: shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents.

critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx:847-857 — filename-lang-picker now correctly binds onLongPress + delayLongPress={350}. Verified via real pointer gesture in browser (not just prop reflection, which react-native-web does not expose on the outer div).

src/lib/push.ts:171-204 — shareViaNative is now a proper discriminated union { kind: 'share' | 'clipboard' | 'cancelled' }. Web branch tries Web Share API first, then falls back to navigator.clipboard.writeText with the exact spec message. Good ordering, and cancel/abort of Web Share is treated as 'cancelled' instead of an error — correct.
PushModal.tsx:134-147 doShare — clipboard kind is displayed with ok:true (green), share/cancelled also with ok:true. Only thrown exceptions surface as red. Matches spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Push Code fixes are verified working on web preview at 390x844. Long-press gesture on filename-lang-picker: use page.mouse.move+down, wait_for_timeout(>400ms), mouse.up — react-native-web Pressable delayLongPress works with real mouse/pointer events. To force the Share clipboard fallback in tests, `delete window.navigator.share` and stub `navigator.clipboard.writeText` before tapping push-share-btn. Push modal contents sit below the 844px viewport bottom on first open — use `el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); el.click()` via page.evaluate to interact with push-tab-*, push-share-btn, and push-status. Success color is Material Green rgb(76,175,80). httpbin.org webhook CORS still an env limitation — untested here per agent note.
